verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of turn-taking, end-of-turn detection, VAD, or interruption handling mechanisms of any kind — nothing addresses how Bland decides when a speaker has finished talking. This is a fair and applicable axis for a voice AI platform, but no capability is documented; missing for 10: any mention of end-of-turn/turn-taking model, VAD configuration, or handling of slow speakers/pauses.
